verdict.rationale: LightSprint explicitly supports bringing your own API keys or existing Codex/Claude subscriptions, picking any model through OpenRouter with no markup on inference, and routing model traffic through an approved gateway. Users can also code locally in Claude or remotely via Codex. All of this comes from vendor marketing copy rather than in-depth docs. Missing for 10: detailed configuration documentation for BYOK/model selection, clarity on which plan tiers include BYOK and gateway routing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
